responsibility: This file implements allocation, recycling, copying, concatenation, and removal utilities for RTL EXPR_LIST and INSN_LIST nodes used by the expander and later RTL code. It maintains per-kind free lists of unused list nodes, provides cached allocators in place of raw gen_rtx_*_LIST creation, and offers helpers for freeing whole lists or individual nodes while preserving REG_NOTE kind fields where relevant. Its focus is efficient lifecycle management of these common RTL list node types.
